collection.title: Saab 9-5 Saloon 2008 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Saab 9-5 Saloon 2008 to 2009 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
